name: Masterwork Armor
description: Intricately laced samurai cuirass armor crafted by legendary armorsmiths for daimyo warlords.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a traditional samurai do-maru chest cuirass armor with shoulder sode plates and crimson lacing cord seams. Centered completely inside a giant solid flat bright crimson red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). High contrast, razor-sharp vector shapes, duotone black and crimson, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
